It builds on the architecture of its predecessors (e.g., GPT‑3 and GPT‑3.5) and has been trained on a vast amount of text data using advanced deep‑learning techniques. • Can process and understand images (multimodal version).
• Handles longer contexts (up to 32 k tokens in some versions).
• Improved reasoning, fewer hallucinations, and better following of instructions compared to earlier models. | | **Training data** | A mixture of data derived from open-weight sources, licensed data, and data derived from OpenAI’s own models.
